text: The imprint of the CRIVIT brand's own website names Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG, Neckarsulm, as the site operator; the site also describes CRIVIT kitting out Lidl-Trek 'from head to toe' through the team partnership.
short: The CRIVIT brand's website is operated by Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG.
